video-multiplexer.none: The cockpit video multiplexer feeds ground/maintenance recording only; it has no flight-deck display or ECAM indication.

wxr.none: the weather radar supply breaker has no ELEC-page alert on the real aircraft; a radar fault is shown by the radar system's own fault page (ATA 34), not by this ELEC supply breaker

xpdr-1.none: the transponder 1 supply breaker has no ELEC-page alert on the real aircraft; the crew would see no transponder reply, a radio-system (ATA 23/34) symptom, not an ELEC-page message, and transponder 2 remains available

xpdr-2.none: MSFS carries one transponder; FlyByWire's RMP does not model selecting XPDR 2, so its supply has nothing to switch off
